findings.note: templates/mutation-incremental/lib/seed.mjs:36 mergeReports keeps only the first report's metadata for a given test-file path (testFileEntries) while it does verify source equality for mutant files; if --from reports disagree on a shared test file's non-tests metadata, the mismatch is silently dropped rather than checked. Low-risk since --from reports are expected to come from the same commit's Stryker output (spec §5.8/§11.6), not adversarial inputs.
